svg.title: Indian SECC region / 80.667 E / 1995–2016 monthly climatology
svg.desc: Equal-year mean of paired yearly monthly vectors; not mean yearly width. Grey: peak-search context, not current edges. Orange: paired 50% crossings. Missing/weak/domain-edge cases remain unresolved. Outside-context crossings do not identify current modes. OSCAR2017.0 / ESR / NOAA PIFSC. Nominal15 m coordinate, near-surface diagnostic; not depth-resolved observations. Local component spans, not flow-normal current widths, annual physical ranges or seasonal current footprints.

cc:Work.dc:description: Equal-year mean of paired yearly monthly vectors; not mean yearly width. Grey: peak-search context, not current edges. Orange: paired 50% crossings. Nominal15 m coordinate, near-surface diagnostic; not depth-resolved observations. Local component spans, not flow-normal current widths, annual physical ranges or seasonal current footprints.
